data.gender_notes: Mohana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mohana is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word ‘mohana’, meaning mountain or hill. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is often depicted as reclining on a mountain, and flowers are symbolic of the divine presence. Thus, Mohana represents a connection to the spiritual realm, evoking images of peace and serenity. The name Mohana carries the meaning “Mountain flower” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mohana usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Mohana, a king mentioned in the Mahabharata, was the ruler of the Vidarbha kingdom. He was a friend and ally of the Pandava brothers, and played a significant role in the Mahabharata war.

Mohana was also a popular name for Jain monks during the 11th and 12th centuries. One such monk, Mohana Suri, was an influential figure in the Digambara sect of Jainism and contributed significantly to the development of Jain philosophy and literature.
